meta.titre: Matching vocabulary items with their definitions

sections.contenu_markdown: In a one-to-one matching exercise, the safest strategy is never to guess randomly on a difficult pair — solve the easy ones first, then use elimination for the rest.

items: Vocabulary range appropriate to Terminale level

sections.titre: Method for matching words to definitions
sections.contenu_markdown: Matching vocabulary to definitions requires identifying the precise semantic core of each word (its essential defining feature) and eliminating already-matched options systematically, since exactly one definition corresponds to each word in a one-to-one matching exercise.

sections.enonce_markdown: Match 'bungalow' with its definition among: a one-storey house / a place where goods are produced / a decision in court.

etapes.justification: A bungalow is a specific type of dwelling.
Only one definition describes a type of house.

items.erreur_markdown: Matching words randomly for the last few pairs when uncertain, instead of using elimination.
items.pourquoi_faux: Since it's a strict one-to-one matching, every already-confirmed pair removes one possibility from the remaining pool, making the last pairs easier to deduce logically rather than guess.
items.correction_markdown: Always match the clearest, most unambiguous pairs first, then use elimination (process of exclusion) for the harder, more ambiguous ones.

items.enonce_markdown: Match 'habitat' with its definition among: a place where an animal lives / a place where people go on holiday.
items.solution_markdown: a place where an animal lives.

items_markdown: Use elimination for remaining, less obvious pairs
